notes.title: Update 10/03
notes.notes:
The latest update brings the following changes to the game:
- A vulnerability issue has been fixed.

Please make sure that you have updated your client to the latest version before playing online matches.

notes.title: AH3X Bug Fix (3rd Mar, 2022)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30812320/ddea15ba303027361bd8eefbcc546322e3ce514a.jpg[/img]
The Steam version of Arcana Heart 3 LOVE MAX SIX STARS!!!!!! XTEND has been updated to fix bugs.


・Fixed freezing bugs
Example：
Using Dark Heart's Super Attacks "Hiyoku Tengen'ha" or "Goudan Messenga"
Using Eko's Critical Heart "Gentlemen!!"
Using Pistrix' Super Attack "Shark Tornado"
Meeting certain conditions when using Life Arcana Parace L'sia
Etc

・Fixed graphical errors
Example：
Certain attacks with the Mirror Arcana when matched against Dark Heart
Using the Blood Arcana Ichor's projectile attacks
Using the Life Arcana Parace L'sia's projectile attacks
Etc

・Fixed a bug that prevented Dark Heart from appearing during Random Character Select.

・Fixed an issue where projectiles would cancel Arcana Burst, projectile-like Critical Hearts, and Arcana Blaze.
(This differed from previous versions)

・Adjusted the behavior of some projectiles, due to the change in screen ratio.

notes.title: AH3X v1.01 Minor update (2021/06/21)
notes.notes:
【Patch fix list】

・Fixed the display for LP and VP values in the results screen at Ranking menu.
*Also, we will need to reset all player's data for this fix to be effective. In addition, the Weekly LP rankings will have to remain with the error values until the next weekly reset.

・Fixed an issue where the game clones a huge number of characters on screen and other display bugs in the training mode while waiting for online matchings.

・Fixed some issues where certain achievements could not be unlocked.

・Fixed an issue where the game crashes upon selecting Dark Heart in Simple Mode, for Versus game mode.

・Fixed an issue where the Player IDs are displayed off-axis in network modes.

The list below contains issues we were unable to reproduce, but have fitted in countermeasures in attempt to fix them:
・The game crashing upon selecting Network Mode, and after display of a short "Downloading..." message

notes.title: ARCANA HEART 3 LOVEMAX SIXSTARS!!!!!! XTEND is now available!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30812320/671d514cfe33352d5342273d025de726361ed057.jpg[/img]
ARCANA HEART 3 LOVEMAX SIXSTARS!!!!!! XTEND, the free update for Arcana Heart 3 LOVEMAX SIXSTARS!!!!!! is now available!

It includes 2 new playable characters (as paid DLC), a new Arcana, 2 new stages, and an upgraded 16:9 aspect ratio.

notes.title: Arcana Heart 3 LOVEMAX SIXSTARS!!!!!! Crowdfunding Edition now available for all kickstarter backers!!!!!!!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30812320/2dacae484dbd68d5901cb1eb765dee7d91582fe2.jpg[/img]
We are pleased to announce that the "Arcana Heart 3 LOVEMAX SIXSTARS!!!!!! Crowdfunding Edition" is now available for all kickstarter backers! Simply locate the new app in your Steam client, install it as you would for a new game, and launch to play!

Currently the only change we have in store is the adaptation to 16:9 battlefield. BUT, as development progresses, we will be having new playable characters and new Arcana up for testing soon!

Also, along with the various changes, certain bugs are expected to be present in some characters' movesets. The developers are tackling the issues as we speak, and we seek your kind patience while we work on that.

In addition, we have added a new option "FPS CONTROL" under Display options. For players who might experience the game speed going off-records, we would recommend you to turn this option on. Reversely, if the game happens to run slow for you, you might want to turn this option off.
*Default is at "ON".

Do look out for further announcements!

*Crowdfunding Edition is only available to Kickstarter backers. We apologize but there is no plan for open public beta testings.

notes.title: 【Ver1.04】Update Notice（2017.12.28）
notes.notes:

・Fixed the noise clippings in many instances of various sound clips.
・Re-introduced the missing character colors.
・Fixed an issue where choosing the "Random" selector will not select both "Minori Amanohara" and "Ichor the Blood Arcana".
・Fixed an issue where the stage BGM for "Ragnarok Hanger" is being played back slower than expected.
・Fixed an issue where the new Six Stars BGMs do not get played back at the correct speed in the Gallery Mode.
・Fixed an issue where the "Player's Skill Level" does not appear correctly while searching for a room in Player Match.
・Fixed an issue where in Training Mode, while controlling 2P, 1P's character will automatically perform the homing dash whenever the player attempts to reset the position.

We are still tackling many other issues in the meantime, and are aiming to release more patches in the very near future. We seek your kind patience and understanding in this matter.

We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused.
